risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain, not a weak or explained-away signal. Phishing mail from look-alike domain aegean-edu.co was delivered (F6) and the user clicked the link (F4); the account then underwent MFA fatigue with 7 denied pushes followed by 1 approval from 185.220.101.7 (F3), corroborated by anomalous sign-ins from BulwarkHost Ltd NL outside baseline and impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa (F5, F2). The same IP (185.220.101.7) then performed 38 successful SIS events within 60 minutes (F1), and an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com established persistence (F7). The rejected password-spray claim concerns a separate shared egress IP and does not affect this account's verified chain. Decision: contain.
